injury_reports.name: Keenan Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen caught all seven targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Josh Downs
injury_reports.summary: Downs caught four of five targets for 23 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: DJ Giddens
injury_reports.summary: Giddens racked up 43 yards on six carries in Indianapolis' Week 8 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Gould
injury_reports.summary: Gould (concussion) does not have a designation for Sunday's matchup versus Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Daniel Jones
injury_reports.summary: The Colts have been contacted by multiple teams regarding the availability of Jones ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

injury_reports.name: Seth McGowan
injury_reports.summary: McGowan rushed five times for 29 yards and returned four kickoffs for 103 yards Sunday in a loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Drew Ogletree
injury_reports.summary: Ogletree (knee) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Richardson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Richardson entered the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday for an ineffective Daniel Jones with 11:45 remaining and completed both his pass attempts for eight yards while rushing twice for four yards.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Taylor
injury_reports.summary: The Colts have an offer of "at least a second-round pick and more" on the table for Taylor but are "holding out for more," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Travis
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Laquon Treadwell
injury_reports.summary: Treadwell caught one of two targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Warren
injury_reports.summary: Warren secured four of 10 targets for 18 yards in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Adetomiwa Adebawore
injury_reports.summary: Adebawore agreed Tuesday with the Colts on a two-year, $35 million contract extension, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Boettcher
injury_reports.summary: Boettcher (groin) was a full participant at the Colts' practice Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Akeem Davis-Gaither
injury_reports.summary: The Colts have ruled out Davis-Gauthier for Sunday's matchup against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Sauce Gardner
injury_reports.summary: Gardner (calf) practiced in full Thursday.

injury_reports.name: A.J. Haulcy
injury_reports.summary: Haulcy (ankle) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Cowboys, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Justin Walley
injury_reports.summary: Walley (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's clash against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Spencer Shrader
injury_reports.summary: Shrader made his sole PAT in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Alec Pierce
injury_reports.summary: When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to return to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

injury_reports.name: Jake Ferguson
injury_reports.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ryan Flournoy
injury_reports.summary: Flournoy caught three of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Goodson
injury_reports.summary: Goodson took seven carries for 14 yards and caught both of his two targets for 19 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss versus the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Hudson
injury_reports.summary: The Cowboys elevated Hudson from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: James Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: The Cowboys elevated Mitchell from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: George Pickens
injury_reports.summary: Pickens (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Indianapolis, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Dak Prescott
injury_reports.summary: Prescott was 19-for-29 passing for 195 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions while rushing seven times for 20 yards and one more TD during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Luke Schoonmaker
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Drew Shelton
injury_reports.summary: Shelton (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (ankle) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Brevyn Spann-Ford
injury_reports.summary: Spann-Ford caught four of five targets for 31 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss versus the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: KaVontae Turpin
injury_reports.summary: Turpin (ribs) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Javonte Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams churned out 56 yards on 24 carries and notched one catch (on two targets) for one yard during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Downs
injury_reports.summary: Downs (concussion) has no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Marist Liufau
injury_reports.summary: Liufau (forearm) was activated from injured reserve Saturday and is questionable for Sunday's contest versus the Colts, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: P.J. Locke
injury_reports.summary: Locke (concussion) holds no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: DeMarvion Overshown
injury_reports.summary: Overshown (hamstring/back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Joey Porter Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Porter (ankle) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Dee Winters
injury_reports.summary: Winters (calf) was a full participant in practice Thursday, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Aubrey
injury_reports.summary: Aubrey made three of his four field-goal attempts and all three PATs in the Cowboys' 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Bullard
injury_reports.summary: Bullard (calf) wasn't activated from injured reserve Saturday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Malachi Lawrence
injury_reports.summary: Dallas placed Lawrence (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Thompson
injury_reports.summary: Thompson (hamstring) has not had his 21-day practice window opened yet, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injury_reports.name: Cyrus Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen caught two of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Noah Gray
injury_reports.summary: Gray caught both of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Emmett Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson carried the ball once for 15 yards and caught all five of his targets for 128 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos. He added 44 yards on his only kickoff return.

injury_reports.name: Travis Kelce
injury_reports.summary: Kelce (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Mahomes
injury_reports.summary: Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos. He added six rushing yards on two carries.

injury_reports.name: Jaylon Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Garrett Nussmeier
injury_reports.summary: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Denver, though he will be available as the team's emergency quarterback.

injury_reports.name: Nikko Remigio
injury_reports.summary: Remigio (hip) has been deemed questionable to suit up against the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Rashee Rice
injury_reports.summary: Rice (hamstring/knee) practiced without limitations Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Kenneth Walker III
injury_reports.summary: Walker carried the ball 21 times for 69 yards and caught four of five targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Worthy
injury_reports.summary: Worthy caught three of six targets for 13 yards during Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Nick Bolton
injury_reports.summary: Bolton registered 11 tackles (six solo) during the Chiefs' 20-3 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chamarri Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to Seattle with seven tackles (two solo).

injury_reports.name: Mansoor Delane
injury_reports.summary: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Friday that Delane (shoulder) will not play Sunday against the Jets, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Drue Tranquill
injury_reports.summary: Tranquill finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 12 tackles (four solo).

injury_reports.name: Nohl Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams finished Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks with 10 tackles (four solo) and one interception.

injury_reports.name: Peter Woods
injury_reports.summary: Woods (neck) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Butker
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Andy Reid said that Butker will remain the Chiefs' kicker for Sunday's game against the Jets, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Omarr Norman-Lott
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs designated Norman-Lott (knee) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: L'Jarius Sneed
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs placed Sneed (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Braelon Allen
injury_reports.summary: Jets coach Aaron Glenn declined to elaborate on the distribution of carries between Allen and Breece Hall, who will return from a five-game absence for Sunday's matchup with Kansas City, ESPN's Rich Cimini reports.

injury_reports.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Cooper and Adonai Mitchell will be the Jets' top wide receivers with Garrett Wilson (concussion) unavailable for Sunday's game at Kansas City, ESPN's Rich Cimini reports.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis rushed five times for 15 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Breece Hall
injury_reports.summary: Hall (quadriceps) "has been medically cleared" and is expected to play Sunday against the Chiefs, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Adonai Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell and Omar Cooper will be the Jets' top wide receivers with Garrett Wilson (concussion) unavailable for Sunday's game at Kansas City, ESPN's Rich Cimini reports.

injury_reports.name: Kene Nwangwu
injury_reports.summary: Nwangwu was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Dylan Parham
injury_reports.summary: Parham (knee) is active for Sunday's game against Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: Kenyon Sadiq
injury_reports.summary: Sadiq caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Geno Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith completed 20 of 32 passes for 290 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He also rushed once for four yards.

injury_reports.name: Mason Taylor
injury_reports.summary: Taylor (back) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught an 18-yard touchdown on his lone target in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Garrett Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson (concussion) is out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

injury_reports.name: David Bailey
injury_reports.summary: Bailey (groin) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Dane Belton
injury_reports.summary: Belton recorded 12 total tackles (eight solo) and a pass defensed in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Joseph Ossai
injury_reports.summary: Ossai (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Phillips
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Jamien Sherwood
injury_reports.summary: Sherwood recorded 14 total tackles (five solo) during Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Trevin Wallace
injury_reports.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Wallace (groin) will not play in Sunday's matchup against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Nahshon Wright
injury_reports.summary: Wright (back) won't suit up Sunday against Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Jason Sanders
injury_reports.summary: Sanders made all four of his field-goal attempts and three PATs in the Jets' 38-33 loss to the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Max Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: The Jets placed Mitchell (concussion) on their injured reserve list Tuesday, Amanda Vogt of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: VJ Payne
injury_reports.summary: Payne (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 9 clash against Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: T'Vondre Sweat
injury_reports.summary: The Jets placed Sweat (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Kaytron Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen (quadriceps) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Lions, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Kevin Coleman Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Coleman caught all three of his targets for 46 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Ollie Gordon II
injury_reports.summary: Gordon carried the ball 19 times for 69 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He failed to catch his only target.

injury_reports.name: Will Kacmarek
injury_reports.summary: Kacmarek (hamstring) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Lions, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Kadyn Proctor
injury_reports.summary: Proctor (concussion) does not have a designation for Sunday's Week 9 matchup versus Detroit, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Malik Washington
injury_reports.summary: Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England.

injury_reports.name: Carlos Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Miami elevated Washington from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's tilt against Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Malik Willis
injury_reports.summary: Willis completed 21 of 32 passes for 211 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England. He gained two rushing yards on his only carry.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Wright
injury_reports.summary: Wright (quadriceps) isn't in line to play in Sunday's game against the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Jordyn Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks recorded 11 tackles (six solo) in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Malik Herring
injury_reports.summary: Herring (neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Rodriguez
injury_reports.summary: Rodriguez notched eight tackles (two solo) and forced a fumble in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Zane Gonzalez
injury_reports.summary: The Dolphins elevated Gonzalez from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Darrell Baker Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Baker (undisclosed) is not ready to return to practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injury_reports.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
injury_reports.summary: Gibbs rushed 23 times for 153 yards and a touchdown while bringing in two of four targets for 15 yards in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jared Goff
injury_reports.summary: Goff completed 18 of 25 passes for 176 yards with a touchdown and an interception and added three carries for no gain in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Sam LaPorta
injury_reports.summary: LaPorta caught three of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings. He added two rushing yards on one attempt.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Saylors
injury_reports.summary: Saylors (neck) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Jabari Small
injury_reports.summary: The Lions elevated Small from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's matchup versus the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
injury_reports.summary: St. Brown (ribs) is slated to play in Sunday's game at Miami, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Sione Vaki
injury_reports.summary: Vaki (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Jameson Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams brought in four of six targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Brian Branch
injury_reports.summary: Branch (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Roger McCreary
injury_reports.summary: McCreary (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Ennis Rakestraw Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Rakestraw (ankle) does not have a game designation for Sunday's Week 8 tilt versus the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: D.J. Reed
injury_reports.summary: Reed (hip) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: DJ Wonnum
injury_reports.summary: Wonnum (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Jake Bates
injury_reports.summary: Bates made two of his three field-goal attempts and his sole PAT in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jack Campbell
injury_reports.summary: The Lions moved Campbell (neck) to injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Kerby Joseph
injury_reports.summary: Joseph (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Cade Mays
injury_reports.summary: Mays (ankle) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Isiah Pacheco
injury_reports.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

injury_reports.name: Kelvin Banks Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Saints activated Banks (ankle) from injured reserve Saturday, and he remains questionable to play Sunday versus Cleveland.

injury_reports.name: Barion Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown hauled in all three targets for 57 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: CJ Donaldson
injury_reports.summary: Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

injury_reports.name: Audric Estime
injury_reports.summary: The Saints claimed Estime off waivers from the Browns on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Noah Fant
injury_reports.summary: Fant gathered in all two targets for 11 yards during Sunday's 16-10 defeat against Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Juwan Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught one of three targets for seven yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Alvin Kamara
injury_reports.summary: Kamara (rest/back) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Lance
injury_reports.summary: Lance reeled in all two targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Asim Richards
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Cesar Ruiz
injury_reports.summary: Ruiz (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Jordyn Tyson
injury_reports.summary: Tyson (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Devaughn Vele
injury_reports.summary: Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Zamir White
injury_reports.summary: The Saints elevated White from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's matchup against Cleveland.

injury_reports.name: Martin Emerson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Emerson (shin) is questionable to suit up for Sunday's Week 9 matchup against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Carl Granderson
injury_reports.summary: Granderson totaled four tackles, including 1.5 sacks, in Sunday's Week 7 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Justin Reid
injury_reports.summary: Reid (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Jonas Sanker
injury_reports.summary: Sanker posted nine tackles (seven solo) in Sunday's Week 7 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Nathan Shepherd
injury_reports.summary: Shepherd (illness) practiced in full Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Pete Werner
injury_reports.summary: Werner finished Sunday's loss to the Steelers with eight tackles (three solo).

injury_reports.name: Charlie Smyth
injury_reports.summary: The Saints elevated Smyth from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints haven't opened Etienne's (hamstring) practice window just yet, Jeff Nowak of WWL Louisiana reports.

items.name: Martin Emerson Jr.
items.impact: Reported Questionable: CB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Asim Richards
items.impact: Reported Questionable: depth at OT may be affected.

items.name: CJ Donaldson
items.impact: Reported Out: depth at RB may be affected.

items.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at RB may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Bond
injury_reports.summary: Bond went without a target while taking the field for eight of the Browns' 70 snaps on offense in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers. He returned one kickoff for 26 yards.

injury_reports.name: Denzel Boston
injury_reports.summary: Boston (calf) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at New Orleans, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

injury_reports.name: KC Concepcion
injury_reports.summary: Concepcion caught three of four targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Malachi Corley
injury_reports.summary: Corley went untargeted while playing 13 of 70 snaps on offense Sunday in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers. He returned one kickoff for 26 yards.

injury_reports.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Fannin (groin) will play Sunday against the Saints, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Dillon Gabriel
injury_reports.summary: Gabriel "will serve as the backup quarterback" Sunday against the Saints, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jerry Jeudy
injury_reports.summary: Jeudy did not catch his lone target Sunday in Cleveland's 27-6 loss to Pittsburgh.

injury_reports.name: Carsen Ryan
injury_reports.summary: The Browns elevated Ryan from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Dylan Sampson
injury_reports.summary: Sampson rushed one time for seven yards and caught six of eight targets for 62 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Shedeur Sanders
injury_reports.summary: Sanders will start at quarterback Sunday against the Saints, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.

injury_reports.name: Tylan Wallace
injury_reports.summary: Wallace recorded a three-yard reception on his lone target in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

injury_reports.name: Deshaun Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson (concussion) is expected to be inactive for Sunday's game at New Orleans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Maliek Collins
injury_reports.summary: out

injury_reports.name: Quincy Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams has no injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.

injury_reports.name: Andre Szmyt
injury_reports.summary: Szmyt made both of his field-goal attempts in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Greg Desrosiers Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Desrosiers could serve as a backup for the Giants on Sunday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalin Hyatt
injury_reports.summary: The Giants signed Hyatt from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Theo Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (neck) was a full participant at the Giants' practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Charlie Jones
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Phil Mafah
injury_reports.summary: The Giants elevated Mafah from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Darnell Mooney
injury_reports.summary: Mooney caught one of three targets for four yards and rushed once for three yards during Sunday's 27-21 overtime win against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Malik Nabers
injury_reports.summary: Nabers (knee) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game in Philadelphia.

injury_reports.name: Devin Singletary
injury_reports.summary: With Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doubtful to play Week 9, Singletary is expected to operate as the Giants' lead back Sunday against the Eagles, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Skattebo
injury_reports.summary: Skattebo (hamstring) -- who is officially listed as doubtful --  "is trying to push to play" Sunday against the Eagles, according to Adam Schefter of ESPN.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Thomas
injury_reports.summary: Thomas (groin) does not have a designation for Sunday's matchup in Philadelphia.

injury_reports.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jameis Winston
injury_reports.summary: Winston turned four carries into four yards and a touchdown during the Giants' 27-21 overtime win over the Texans on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Abdul Carter
injury_reports.summary: Carter (illness) returned to practice Thursday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jevon Holland
injury_reports.summary: Holland (concussion) was not listed on the Giants' injury report Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Colton Hood
injury_reports.summary: Hood (illness) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Micah McFadden
injury_reports.summary: McFadden notched 10 tackles (all solo) in Sunday's 27-21 overtime win against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Greg Newsome II
injury_reports.summary: Newsome (concussion) wasn't listed on the Giants' injury report Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Arvell Reese
injury_reports.summary: Reese posted seven tackles (five solo), including 0.5 sacks, in Sunday's 27-21 overtime victory against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Dominic Zvada
injury_reports.summary: Head coach John Harbaugh reiterated Monday that he's confident in Zvada and said that the Giants have no plans to work out other kickers, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.

items.name: Cam Skattebo
items.impact: Reported Doubtful: RB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Charlie Jones
items.impact: Reported Questionable: WR starter availability could change this week's rotation.

injury_reports.name: Jaden Bradley
injury_reports.summary: The Commanders elevated Bradley from their practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's matchup versus the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Treylon Burks
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Jayden Daniels
injury_reports.summary: Daniels completed 16 of 29 passes for 217 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for 23 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Stefon Diggs
injury_reports.summary: Diggs caught three of six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Austin Ekeler
injury_reports.summary: Ekeler rushed eight times for 36 yards in Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Robert Henry Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Commanders claimed Henry off waivers from the Seahawks on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Chig Okonkwo
injury_reports.summary: Okonkwo tallied two catches (on four targets) for 32 yards during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Tanoa Togiai
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Rachaad White
injury_reports.summary: White rushed 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for five yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Antonio Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Fabian Moreau
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
injury_reports.summary: The Commanders activated Newton (pectoral) from injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Charles Omenihu
injury_reports.summary: Omenihu (groin/ankle) is active for Sunday night's contest against the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Isaac Yiadom
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Drew Stevens
injury_reports.summary: Stevens made four of his five field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

injury_reports.name: Dyami Brown
injury_reports.summary: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Javon Kinlaw
injury_reports.summary: Kinlaw underwent season-ending surgery Tuesday to repair his MCL, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Terry McLaurin
injury_reports.summary: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremy McNichols
injury_reports.summary: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Daron Payne
injury_reports.summary: Payne (foot) underwent season-ending surgery Wednesday, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Corum
injury_reports.summary: Corum rushed 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown and failed to bring in his only target in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Higbee
injury_reports.summary: Higbee caught one of two targets for 14 yards against the Chargers in Sunday's 24-9 victory.

injury_reports.name: Puka Nacua
injury_reports.summary: Nacua secured 11 of 12 targets for 80 yards and a touchdown in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Colby Parkinson
injury_reports.summary: Parkinson (ribs) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Ronnie Rivers
injury_reports.summary: The Rams activated Rivers (calf) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Stafford
injury_reports.summary: Stafford (right elbow) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Sarah Barshop of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Whittington
injury_reports.summary: Whittington (back) is questionable for Sunday's matchup against Washington, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Kyren Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams rushed 16 times for 56 yards and a touchdown and brought in his sole target for three yards in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kam Curl
injury_reports.summary: Curl (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Myles Garrett
injury_reports.summary: Garrett (knee) was activated from injured reserve Saturday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game at Washington.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Lake
injury_reports.summary: Lake recorded seven total tackles (two solo) and two passes defensed, including an interception, during Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Trent McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie (back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Commanders, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Grant Stuard
injury_reports.summary: Stuard is battling a hamstring injury, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Joe Cardona
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Joshua Karty
injury_reports.summary: The Rams signed Karty to their active roster Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Brandon McManus
injury_reports.summary: McManus converted his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dean Connors
injury_reports.summary: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Terrance Ferguson
injury_reports.summary: Ferguson (ankle) was expected to return for Sunday's game against Washington, but he's been ruled out after injuring his hamstring during Friday's practice, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Watson
injury_reports.summary: The Rams placed Watson (shoulder) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Corey Bullock
injury_reports.summary: Bullock (quadriceps) was a full participant at the Panthers' practice Thursday, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.

injury_reports.name: Brady Christensen
injury_reports.summary: Christensen (hamstring), who is on IR, has been ruled out for Sunday's battle against the Broncos, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Coker
injury_reports.summary: Coker secured two of five targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Chuba Hubbard
injury_reports.summary: Hubbard rushed 22 times for 81 yards and a touchdown and brought in seven of eight targets for 38 yards in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Damien Lewis
injury_reports.summary: Lewis (knee) won't play Sunday against Denver.

injury_reports.name: Tetairoa McMillan
injury_reports.summary: McMillan brought in six of 11 targets for 57 yards in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: John Metchie III
injury_reports.summary: Metchie recorded three receptions for 14 yards on three targets in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: David Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore didn't receive any playing time on offense and logged two snaps on special teams in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Torricelli Simpkins III
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brycen Tremayne
injury_reports.summary: Tremayne finished with an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Darren Waller
injury_reports.summary: Waller corralled one of two targets for 11 yards during last Thursday's 27-19 loss at Green Bay.

injury_reports.name: Bryce Young
injury_reports.summary: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Friday that Young (ankle) is ready for Sunday's game against Denver after a "great week" of practice, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Bobby Brown III
injury_reports.summary: Brown (hand) practiced fully Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Will Lee III
injury_reports.summary: Lee has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Denver due to a hamstring injury.

injury_reports.name: Bobby Okereke
injury_reports.summary: Okereke (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Jaelan Phillips
injury_reports.summary: Phillips (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 9 battle against the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Zakee Wheatley
injury_reports.summary: Wheatley recorded seven total tackles (four solo) and an interception during Thursday night's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Marco Wilson
injury_reports.summary: The Panthers elevated Wilson from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ryan Fitzgerald
injury_reports.summary: Fitzgerald made both field-goal attempts and converted his only extra-point try in Thursday's 27-19 loss to Green Bay.

injury_reports.name: Jonathon Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks (core) was seen working off to the side during the Panthers' unofficial practice Tuesday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Akayleb Evans
injury_reports.summary: Evans (triceps) was placed on injured reserve by the Panthers on Thursday, Darin Gantt of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Legette
injury_reports.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Nate Adkins
injury_reports.summary: Adkins caught both of his targets for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Jonah Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 63 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: J.K. Dobbins
injury_reports.summary: Dobbins carried the ball seven times for 13 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Sam Ehlinger
injury_reports.summary: Ehlinger (coach's decision) is inactive but will be the third emergency quarterback against the Chiefs on Sunday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Evan Engram
injury_reports.summary: Engram failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Bo Nix
injury_reports.summary: Nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City. He added four rushing yards on three carries and threw a two-point conversion to Jaylen Waddle.

injury_reports.name: Cody Schrader
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos elevated Schrader from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's matchup in Carolina, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Courtland Sutton
injury_reports.summary: Sutton (undisclosed) briefly left Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Waddle
injury_reports.summary: Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Kris Abrams-Draine
injury_reports.summary: Abrams-Draine (ankle) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Zach Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen (hamstring) is active for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Talanoa Hufanga
injury_reports.summary: Hufanga (ankle) will be a game-time decision for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones (hamstring) is officially listed as out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Taylor Rapp
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos signed Rapp off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

injury_reports.name: Alex Singleton
injury_reports.summary: Singleton notched 14 tackles (six solo), including 1.0 sacks, and defensed a pass in Sunday's 28-24 victory against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Dondrea Tillman
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Wil Lutz
injury_reports.summary: Lutz made both field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Pat Bryant
injury_reports.summary: Bryant (ankle) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game in Carolina, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Eyioma Uwazurike
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos placed Uwazurike (shoulder) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Joe Alt
injury_reports.summary: Alt (neck) was not listed on the Chargers' official injury report Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Kayode Awosika
injury_reports.summary: doubtful

injury_reports.name: Oronde Gadsden
injury_reports.summary: Gadsden caught all five of his targets for 52 yards during Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Omarion Hampton
injury_reports.summary: Hampton rushed nine times for 20 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tre' Harris
injury_reports.summary: Harris caught all three of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Justin Herbert
injury_reports.summary: Herbert completed 24 of 32 passes for 257 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions while rushing four times for 15 yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Johnston
injury_reports.summary: Johnston caught all four of his targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Charlie Kolar
injury_reports.summary: Kolar caught one of four targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
injury_reports.summary: Lambert-Smith did not garner a target during Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Ladd McConkey
injury_reports.summary: McConkey brought in four of six targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Keaton Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell rushed four times for six yards and caught all three of his targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Brenen Thompson
injury_reports.summary: Thompson (quadriceps/hamstring) is officially listed as doubtful for Sunday's game versus the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Kimani Vidal
injury_reports.summary: Vidal rushed eight times for 23 yards and caught both of his targets for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Daiyan Henley
injury_reports.summary: Henley (shoulder) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Donte Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (hamstring) does not have a designation for Sunday's tilt against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Deane Leonard
injury_reports.summary: Leonard (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 9 clash against Houston.

injury_reports.name: Rodney Shelley
injury_reports.summary: Shelley (ankle) has no designation for Sunday's tilt against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Kendall Williamson
injury_reports.summary: Williamson (calf) has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup versus the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Cameron Dicker
injury_reports.summary: Dicker made all three of his field-goal attempts during Sunday's 24-9 loss against the Rams. He did not kick any extra-point tries.

injury_reports.name: Derwin James Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Chargers placed James (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: David Njoku
injury_reports.summary: Njoku (fibula) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Texans.

injury_reports.name: Denzel Perryman
injury_reports.summary: Perryman (undisclosed) has been deemed doubtful to suit up against Houston on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kayshon Boutte
injury_reports.summary: Boutte caught one of two targets for 25 yards during Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss versus the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Nico Collins
injury_reports.summary: Collins caught two of five targets for six yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Blake Fisher
injury_reports.summary: Fisher (thumb) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Harrison caught one of four targets for a six-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Hutchinson
injury_reports.summary: Hutchinson caught three of six targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added 12 rushing yards on two attempts.

injury_reports.name: Woody Marks
injury_reports.summary: With David Montgomery (groin) again ruled out for Week 9, Marks is expected to remain the Texans' clear RB1 for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury_reports.name: David Montgomery
injury_reports.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Wednesday that Montgomery (groin) has made some progress but is still viewed as week-to-week and will remain out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

injury_reports.name: Foster Moreau
injury_reports.summary: Moreau played 21 offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps in the Texans' 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jaylin Noel
injury_reports.summary: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

injury_reports.name: Dare Ogunbowale
injury_reports.summary: Ogunbowale didn't record an offensive touch or target in Sunday's 24-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Dalton Schultz
injury_reports.summary: Schultz caught five of six targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: C.J. Stroud
injury_reports.summary: Stroud completed 17 of 28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added two rushing attempts for four yards and threw a successful two-point conversion.

injury_reports.name: Azeez Al-Shaair
injury_reports.summary: Al-Shaair (groin) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Reed Blankenship
injury_reports.summary: Blankenship (concussion/hand) has been ruled out to face the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Naquan Jones
injury_reports.summary: The Texans signed Jones on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Pitre
injury_reports.summary: Pitre (shoulder) was a full participant in Houston's practice Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: M.J. Stewart
injury_reports.summary: Stewart finished with 12 tackles (five solo), including 0.5 sacks, and a defensed pass in Sunday's overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Henry To'oTo'o
injury_reports.summary: To'oTo'o notched 10 tackles (three solo), including 0.5 sacks, in Sunday's Week 7 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Ka'imi Fairbairn
injury_reports.summary: Fairbairn went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and converted his only PAT in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: Tank Dell
injury_reports.summary: Dell caught his only target for 43 yards and added a two-yard rush during Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

injury_reports.name: A.J. Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown (knee/ankle) remained sidelined at practice Friday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

injury_reports.name: Marcus Bryant
injury_reports.summary: Bryant (ankle) was activated from injured reserve by the Patriots on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Efton Chism III
injury_reports.summary: Chism caught all five of his targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: DeMario Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: TreVeyon Henderson
injury_reports.summary: Henderson (illness) won't play Sunday against the Packers, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Hunter Henry
injury_reports.summary: Henry (foot) "has a realistic chance to play" Sunday against the Packers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Mack Hollins
injury_reports.summary: The Patriots activated Hollins (calf) from injured reserve Saturday, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game against the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Corey Kiner
injury_reports.summary: Kiner rushed seven times for 38 yards during Sunday's 24-19 win over Miami.

injury_reports.name: Drake Maye
injury_reports.summary: Maye completed 16 of 20 passes for 199 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins. He added five rushing yards and a TD on eight carries.

injury_reports.name: Morgan Moses
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Eli Raridon
injury_reports.summary: Raridon had one reception for five yards on four targets in New England's 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
injury_reports.summary: With TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 9, Stevenson is set to handle an expanded workload Sunday against the Packers, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams caught his lone target for a 43-yard touchdown during Sunday's 24-19 win over the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Gabe Jacas
injury_reports.summary: Jacas (knee) does not have a designation for Sunday's contest versus Green Bay.

injury_reports.name: Brenden Schooler
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Andy Borregales
injury_reports.summary: Borregales made one of his two field goals and all three PATs in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Greg Van Roten
injury_reports.summary: Van Roten (hamstring) wasn't activated from IR ahead of Sunday's tilt against the Packers, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

injury_reports.name: Aaron Banks
injury_reports.summary: Banks (knee) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Drake Dabney
injury_reports.summary: The Packers elevated Dabney from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Travis Glover
injury_reports.summary: Glover (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Golden
injury_reports.summary: Golden brought in seven of 13 targets for 79 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_reports.summary: Jacobs doesn't anticipate missing any additional game action due to the release of additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse against him, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Tucker Kraft
injury_reports.summary: Kraft secured all six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: MarShawn Lloyd
injury_reports.summary: Lloyd (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Love
injury_reports.summary: Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Sean Rhyan
injury_reports.summary: Rhyan (ankle) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson (ribs) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest at New England.

injury_reports.name: Josh Whyle
injury_reports.summary: Whyle (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Zaire Franklin
injury_reports.summary: Franklin (shin) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ty'Ron Hopper
injury_reports.summary: Hopper recorded eight tackles, including 1.0 sacks, and three defensed passes, including an interception, in last Thursday's 27-19 victory over Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie finished last Thursday's 27-19 win over Carolina with 10 tackles (three solo).

injury_reports.name: Keisean Nixon
injury_reports.summary: Nixon (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Evan Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams recorded 10 total tackles (seven solo) during Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Devonte Wyatt
injury_reports.summary: Wyatt (ankle) is active for Thursday's game against the Panthers, Mike Spofford of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey Smack
injury_reports.summary: Smack converted three of four extra-point tries and didn't attempt a field goal Thursday in a 27-19 win over Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Chris Brooks
injury_reports.summary: The Packers didn't activate Brooks (ankle) from injured reserve Saturday, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Micah Parsons
injury_reports.summary: Parsons (knee) officially was ruled out for Sunday's contest in New England.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Aiyuk
injury_reports.summary: Prior to meeting with 49ers officials Friday, Aiyuk (personal) told assembled media that he's "feeling great, healthy" and "looking to get reinstated to the National Football League," Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandin Cooks
injury_reports.summary: Cooks caught one of three targets for 13 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Cowing
injury_reports.summary: Cowing caught three of five passes for 38 yards, added a 10-yard carry and returned one kickoff for 28 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Mike Evans
injury_reports.summary: Evans (Achilles), who won't play in Sunday's game against the Raiders, appears to be "questionable at best" for next Sunday's road matchup with the Cowboys, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: KhaDarel Hodge
injury_reports.summary: The 49ers elevated Hodge from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Jordan James
injury_reports.summary: James logged a six-yard carry, turned his lone target into an 11-yard catch and registered 119 yards on four kickoff returns during the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Juszczyk
injury_reports.summary: Juszczyk caught all three of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Christian McCaffrey
injury_reports.summary: McCaffrey is expected to take on a full workload Sunday against the Raiders, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Brock Purdy
injury_reports.summary: Purdy completed 27 of 40 passes for 288 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and added two carries for five yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Demarcus Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson (ankle) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, per Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area, and the 49ers removed his questionable designation for Sunday's game versus the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Samuel (hamstring) didn't participate in the early portion of Friday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Watkins
injury_reports.summary: Watkins brought in three of six targets for 56 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Nick Bosa
injury_reports.summary: Bosa (knee) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: Luke Gifford
injury_reports.summary: Gifford (groin) does not have a designation for Sunday's Week 9 tilt against the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Dre Greenlaw
injury_reports.summary: Greenlaw posted 12 tackles (four solo) in Sunday's loss to the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Siran Neal
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Marques Sigle
injury_reports.summary: Sigle (ankle) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Upton Stout
injury_reports.summary: Stout (shoulder) was only active as an emergency depth option during Sunday's loss to the Falcons, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reported Monday.

injury_reports.name: Garret Wallow
injury_reports.summary: Wallow (hamstring) does not have a designation for Sunday's clash against Las Vegas.

injury_reports.name: Fred Warner
injury_reports.summary: Warner recorded 13 tackles (six solo) Sunday in a Week 7 loss to Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Eddy Pineiro
injury_reports.summary: Pineiro did not attempt a field goal while going 2-for-3 on PATs in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Nate Hobbs
injury_reports.summary: San Francisco didn't activate Hobbs (groin) from injured reserve Saturday, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Kirk
injury_reports.summary: The 49ers placed Kirk (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
injury_reports.summary: Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Jack Bech
injury_reports.summary: Bech finished without a target or touch in Sunday's 38-33 Week 8 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Brock Bowers
injury_reports.summary: Bowers caught seven of 10 targets for 92 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Kirk Cousins
injury_reports.summary: Cousins completed 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets. He added five rushing attempts for three yards and a rushing touchdown.

injury_reports.name: Ashton Jeanty
injury_reports.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that the breakdown in carries between Jeanty and Mike Washington will be determined on a week-to-week basis, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Mayer
injury_reports.summary: Mayer caught five of six targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Fernando Mendoza
injury_reports.summary: Mendoza didn't play in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Nailor
injury_reports.summary: Nailor caught all four targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Thornton (back) does not have a designation for Sunday's battle against San Francisco, Paul Gutierrez of the Raiders' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tre Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker did not catch his only target Sunday in the Raiders' 38-33 Week 8 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Mike Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that the breakdown in carries between Washington and Ashton Jeanty will be determined on a week-to-week basis, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Cody White
injury_reports.summary: White was signed by the Raiders on Thursday, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Thomas Booker IV
injury_reports.summary: Booker (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game in San Francisco, Paul Gutierrez of the Raiders' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremy Chinn
injury_reports.summary: Chinn recorded 10 total tackles (four solo) and an interception during Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Nakobe Dean
injury_reports.summary: Dean recorded 12 total tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 38-33 victory against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Darien Porter
injury_reports.summary: Porter (groin) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Matt Gay
injury_reports.summary: Gay converted his sole field-goal attempt and all five PATs in the Raiders' 38-33 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: AJ Barner
injury_reports.summary: Barner brought in two of five targets for 23 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_reports.summary: Charbonnet (knee) rushed six times for 23 yards and brought in three of four targets for six yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Charles Cross
injury_reports.summary: Cross (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 9 tilt against the Cardinals, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Sam Darnold
injury_reports.summary: Darnold (quadriceps) may miss Seattle's Week 10 game at Las Vegas, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Montorie Foster Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Seahawks elevated Foster from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: George Holani
injury_reports.summary: Holani carried once for nine yards and failed to haul in his lone target in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears. He also returned six kickoffs for 144 yards.

injury_reports.name: Tory Horton
injury_reports.summary: Horton recorded three receptions for 26 yards on six targets in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Cooper Kupp
injury_reports.summary: Kupp caught one of three targets for a seven-yard touchdown Monday in a loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Drew Lock
injury_reports.summary: Lock (right elbow) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest against the Cardinals, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Milroe
injury_reports.summary: Milroe will get added reps at practice ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cardinals, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Quenton Nelson
injury_reports.summary: Nelson (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Jadarian Price
injury_reports.summary: Price rushed 10 times for 29 yards and brought in two of four targets for eight yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Rashid Shaheed
injury_reports.summary: Shaheed (knee) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Gregg Bell of 933 KJR reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
injury_reports.summary: Smith-Njigba brought in six of 11 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Emanuel Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson played just seven snaps -- all on special teams -- in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Ernest Jones IV
injury_reports.summary: Jones (ankle) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus Arizona, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Uchenna Nwosu
injury_reports.summary: Nwosu (ankle) is officially listed as out for Sunday's game versus the Cardinals, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Connor O'Toole
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brandon Pili
injury_reports.summary: Pili (back) has been ruled out to face Arizona on Sunday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Leonard Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (shoulder) is officially listed as out for Sunday's game versus Arizona, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jason Myers
injury_reports.summary: Myers missed his lone field-goal attempt and made one of two PATs in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier is slated to work as Arizona's No. 1 running back beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle after Jeremiyah Love (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Beck will serve as the Cardinals' No. 2 quarterback behind starter Gardner Minshew in Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Shawn Bowman
injury_reports.summary: Arizona elevated Bowman from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Devin Duvernay
injury_reports.summary: Duvernay caught both of his targets for 14 yards while also adding 75 yards as a kick returner and 12 punt-return yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime win against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Simi Fehoko
injury_reports.summary: Fehoko is listed as a starting receiver on the Cardinals' unofficial depth chart heading into Sunday's game at Seattle, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jerome Ford
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals elevated Ford from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Jon Gaines II
injury_reports.summary: Gaines (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 9 matchup versus the Seahawks, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Elijah Higgins
injury_reports.summary: Higgins tallied two catches for 10 yards on four targets Sunday in a 33-30 overtime win over Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: Knight (concussion) is out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Gardner Minshew II
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur announced that Minshew will step in as the Cardinals' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Reggie Virgil
injury_reports.summary: Virgil failed to reel in either of his targets during Sunday's 33-30 overtime victory against Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Wallace III
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals signed Wallace from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Jayden Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest in Seattle, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson (rest/ribs) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest in Seattle, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Max Melton
injury_reports.summary: Melton (knee) is questionable to play against Seattle on Sunday, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Walter Nolen III
injury_reports.summary: Nolen (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's Week 9 tilt against the Seahawks, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland converted both of his field-goal attempts and three of four PATs in Sunday's 33-30 overtime win over the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Adams
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals activated Adams (ankle) off injured reserve Saturday, and he remains questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: James Conner
injury_reports.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiyah Love
injury_reports.summary: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Salvon Ahmed
injury_reports.summary: The Bears elevated Ahmed from their practice squad to the active roster Saturday ahead of Sunday's matchup against the Buccaneers.

injury_reports.name: Luther Burden III
injury_reports.summary: Burden secured seven of nine targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Stephen Carlson
injury_reports.summary: Chicago signed Carlson from its practice squad to its 53-man roster Wednesday, Brendan Sugrue of USA Today reports.

injury_reports.name: Roschon Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson carried five times for 17 yards and added an 11-yard reception on his lone target in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Case Keenum
injury_reports.summary: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will operate as the Bears' emergency third quarterback for Monday night's matchup against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Colston Loveland
injury_reports.summary: Loveland secured seven of nine targets for 65 yards and lost a fumble in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_reports.summary: Monangai (thumb/toe) isn't slated to play in Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, but he's expected to return after the Bears' Week 10 bye in a Week 11 matchup with the Saints, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Rome Odunze
injury_reports.summary: Odunze brought in four of six targets for 87 yards in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kalif Raymond
injury_reports.summary: Raymond finished Monday's 34-17 win against Seattle with two catches for 14 yards on three targets along with one rush for 39 yards.

injury_reports.name: Sam Roush
injury_reports.summary: Roush went without a target while playing 37 of the Bears' 70 snaps on offense in Monday's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: D'Andre Swift
injury_reports.summary: Swift rushed 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns and brought in two of three targets for 10 yards in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams completed 24 of 34 passes for 247 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions and rushed twice for one yard in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Grady Jarrett
injury_reports.summary: Jarrett (groin) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Buccaneers.

injury_reports.name: Malik Muhammad II
injury_reports.summary: Muhammad (toe) "should be good to go" for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Jack Sanborn
injury_reports.summary: Sanborn (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Tyrique Stevenson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson (thumb) "should be good to go" for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Cairo Santos
injury_reports.summary: Santos made both field-goal tries and all four PATs in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Braxton Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones (knee) is out for the rest of the season, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.

injury_reports.name: Zavier Scott
injury_reports.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Kentavius Street
injury_reports.summary: The Bears placed Street (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Jahns of AllCHGO.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Graham Barton
injury_reports.summary: Barton (illness) is active for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Emeka Egbuka
injury_reports.summary: Egbuka (foot), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Chicago, is slated to return to action, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Kenny Gainwell
injury_reports.summary: Gainwell (hip) was a full practice participant Thursday, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Godwin failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Luke Goedeke
injury_reports.summary: Goedeke (calf) is active for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ted Hurst III
injury_reports.summary: Hurst failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Bucky Irving
injury_reports.summary: Irving rushed 27 times for 170 yards and a touchdown in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tez Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson did not garner a target during Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Baker Mayfield
injury_reports.summary: Mayfield failed to complete any of his three pass attempts in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday. He also rushed four times for 14 yards.

injury_reports.name: Cade Otton
injury_reports.summary: Otton wasn't targeted in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Bauer Sharp
injury_reports.summary: Sharp went without a target while playing 19 of the Buccaneers' 60 snaps on offense in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Sean Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker didn't play any offensive snaps in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Tristan Wirfs
injury_reports.summary: Wirfs (toe) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Alex Anzalone
injury_reports.summary: Anzalone recorded six total tackles (three solo) and two interceptions in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Yaya Diaby
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles said that Diaby (knee) has been diagnosed with an MCL sprain and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Bears, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Parrish
injury_reports.summary: Parrish registered seven total tackles (four solo) and two passes defensed, including an interception, during Sunday's 16-0 win over Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Tykee Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (ankle) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Josiah Trotter
injury_reports.summary: Trotter recorded six total tackles (two solo) during Sunday's 16-0 victory over Atlanta.

injury_reports.name: Antoine Winfield Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Winfield (ribs) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Chase McLaughlin
injury_reports.summary: McLaughlin made all three field-goal attempts and his only extra-point try in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Josh Hayes
injury_reports.summary: Hayes suffered a small setback in his recovery from a knee injury, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen McMillan
injury_reports.summary: McMillan (knee) isn't expected back until after Tampa Bay's Week 10 bye, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
