injury_reports.name: Jordan Addison
injury_reports.summary: Addison caught three of eight targets for 66 yards in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Odell Beckham Jr.
injury_reports.summary: The Vikings are signing Beckham from the practice squad to the active roster, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Max Brosmer
injury_reports.summary: Brosmer is set to back up Carson Wentz against the Bills on Monday, as Kyler Murray (hamstring) won't play, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Demond Claiborne
injury_reports.summary: Claiborne (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's battle against Buffalo, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: DeeJay Dallas
injury_reports.summary: Dallas was signed to the Vikings' active roster Wednesday, Craig Peters of the team's official website reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Darrisaw
injury_reports.summary: Darrisaw (shoulder) was a full practice participant Friday.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Hockenson
injury_reports.summary: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Jauan Jennings
injury_reports.summary: Jennings (calf) has been ruled out for Monday's contest versus the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Jones rushed five times for 22 yards and brought in both targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Murray
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Saturday that Murray (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game versus the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Carson Wentz
injury_reports.summary: Wentz is stated to start Monday night's game against the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Cashman
injury_reports.summary: Cashman finished Sunday's loss to Detroit with 10 tackles (five solo).

injury_reports.name: Joshua Metellus
injury_reports.summary: Metellus recorded 13 tackles (six solo) and a defensed pass in a Week 8 defeat against Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Byron Murphy Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Murphy registered 10 tackles (eight solo) in a loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Van Ginkel
injury_reports.summary: Van Ginkel (chest) doesn't have a designation for Monday's matchup against the Bills, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jay Ward
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Eric Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson registered 11 tackles, including 1.0 sacks, in Sunday's loss to Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Will Reichard
injury_reports.summary: Reichard missed his sole field-goal attempt and made his sole PAT in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Mason
injury_reports.summary: Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Josh Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen completed 21 of 34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens. He added 30 rushing yards and a rushing touchdown on seven rushing attempts.

injury_reports.name: Alec Anderson
injury_reports.summary: Anderson (ankle) is questionable for Monday's tilt versus the Vikings.

injury_reports.name: Spencer Brown
injury_reports.summary: Brown (back) does not have a designation for Monday's matchup in Minnesota.

injury_reports.name: Keon Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman (shoulder) doesn't have a designation for Monday's contest in Minnesota.

injury_reports.name: James Cook III
injury_reports.summary: Cook rushed 21 times for 80 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Ray Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis rushed six times for 30 yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Dion Dawkins
injury_reports.summary: Dawkins (ribs) is officially questionable to suit up against the Vikings in Week 9.

injury_reports.name: Greg Dortch
injury_reports.summary: Dortch went without a target while logging four of the Bills' 82 snaps on offense in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens. He returned one kickoff for 22 yards and three punts for 40 yards.

injury_reports.name: Ty Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (illness) was a full practice participant Friday.

injury_reports.name: Dalton Kincaid
injury_reports.summary: Kincaid (chest) was a full participant in Friday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Dawson Knox
injury_reports.summary: Knox caught one of two targets for six yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: DJ Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (shoulder) doesn't have a designation for Monday's contest at Minnesota.

injury_reports.name: Joshua Palmer
injury_reports.summary: Palmer (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game in Minnesota, Maddy Glab of the Bills' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Khalil Shakir
injury_reports.summary: Shakir caught five of six targets for 64 yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Dee Alford
injury_reports.summary: Alford (ankle) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Greg Gaines
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Tyler Bass
injury_reports.summary: Bass made all three of his field-goal attempts as well as three PATs in the Bills' 36-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Hancock
injury_reports.summary: Hancock (hamstring) was designated to return from injured reserve by the Bills on Wednesday, Sal Capaccio of WGR Sports Radio 550 Buffalo reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyrell Shavers
injury_reports.summary: Shavers (knee) is listed as questionable ahead of Monday night's game against the Vikings, Maddy Glab of the Bills' official site reports.
